title: Points Reversed on a Cancelled Grooming Pass — Rewards Ledger Computation (Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus)
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus — the number of points reversed when a grooming pass that earned points is cancelled and its unused visits are refunded.**

**Inputs.**
- From the rewards ledger: the points earning entry of the pass purchase — the points it earned, its qualifying spend and its date.
- From the Tailwise Grooming Salon records of the cancelled pass: the pass refund — the amount refunded and the refund date.
- From the membership record: the current points balance.

**Reversal.** The points to reverse are the points the pass purchase earned times the amount refunded divided by the pass purchase's qualifying spend, rounded down to a whole point.

**Order of working.** The points to reverse are settled first; any share then applied to them is applied next, its result rounded down to a whole point; any points kept back are then subtracted; the result is never below zero; and the two caps apply last.

**Caps.** The reversal is never more than the points the pass purchase earned, and a reversal larger than the current points balance takes the balance only to zero — the points reversed are the lowest of the figure worked out, the points the pass purchase earned, and the current balance.

**Worked figures (hypothetical).**

| | Case A | Case B |
|---|---|---|
| Points the pass purchase earned | 1,560 | 1,560 |
| Pass purchase qualifying spend | $130.00 | $130.00 |
| Amount refunded | $65.00 | $97.50 |
| 1,560 times refund divided by spend | 780 | 1,170 |
| Current points balance | 2,400 | 900 |
| Points reversed | 780 | 900 (balance taken to zero) |
